title: Eleven 'Workbench entity' names in v4 are ACE entities with no row in the Ownership Map
source: 06 Data/Recovery Workbench Source to Target Mapping v4.xlsx
description: The Mapping sheet names 25 entities. Eleven of them - party, contact_point, loan_account, account_payment, collateral, account_collateral, valuation, asset, score, collections_history and party_product - are ACE entities read through the recovery.v_ace_* views. The Ownership Map sheet Tables has no row for any of them; it holds party_ext, contact_point_ext, account_ext and valuation_ext as the P1 Workbench tables. The source therefore mixes source entities and target tables in one column.
evidence: Ownership Map sheet Tables has 93 rows and none is named party, loan_account, account_payment, collateral, account_collateral, asset, score, collections_history, party_product, contact_point or valuation; the v4 rows for these entities read v_ace_* paths; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 line 509 (Recovery loads no source data; rwb-source-data reads ACE through the 30 read-only recovery.v_ace_* views) and line 2079 (schema recovery holds 30 v_ace_* views, SELECT only, for rwb_source_data).
proposed: Keep the entity names word for word; give every such field target schema rwb_source_data and owner P1, read through the rwb-source-data contract (DP-05, ADR-010); add the four extension tables to the Mapping as Workbench targets when the document is next revised.

title: v4 has no owner column and no target schema, so ownership is carried only by the Ownership Map
source: 06 Data/Recovery Workbench Source to Target Mapping v4.xlsx
section: Mapping (columns A to N) and Mapping rules
description: All 133 field rows name a Workbench entity and a read path, but no cell says which service or schema receives the field, and the Mapping rules speak of one recovery schema as the target. The Ownership Map assigns every Workbench table to one of the 19 services, so the owner and the rwb_<name> schema are derived here rather than stated in the source.
evidence: v4 Mapping header is 14 columns (Field ID to Status) with no owner or schema column; v4 Mapping rules row 1 and row 5 name the recovery schema as the single target; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 line 635 (ACE PostgreSQL: ACE schemas, 30 recovery.v_ace_* views, 19 rwb_* schemas, one login each) and line 2147 (19 Recovery schemas rwb_<service>); Ownership Map sheet Tables (Table, Owner, Schema).
proposed: Add 'Target schema' and 'Owning service' to the Mapping and to the ACE gaps sheet, one value per row from the Ownership Map sheet Tables; keep columns A to N unchanged.

title: The 'By source' sheet counts the extension field against ACE table 'recovery'
source: 06 Data/Recovery Workbench Source to Target Mapping v4.xlsx
section: By source (row Aric via COLLINS, column ACE table(s))
description: The Aric via COLLINS row carries 1 field, marked Extension, with ACE table(s) 'recovery'. 'recovery' is the monolith schema, not an ACE table: the field is DF-PTY-021 fraud_flag in recovery.party_ext, a Workbench extension table. After the realignment the extension table sits in rwb_source_data and schema recovery holds only the read-only v_ace_* views.
evidence: v4 Mapping row DF-PTY-021 (ACE object column recovery.party_ext.fraud_flag, read path recovery.party_ext); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 line 2079 (schema recovery: 30 v_ace_* views, SELECT only) and line 1079 (rwb_source_data holds the ACE view contract and the extension tables); Ownership Map sheet Tables row party_ext (owner P1, schema rwb_source_data).
proposed: Read rwb_source_data.party_ext in that cell; leave the 1/0/0/1 counts and the Total row unchanged.

title: Five rows still cite 'number in Interface Specifications v3' after v4 of that document was issued
source: 06 Data/Recovery Workbench Source to Target Mapping v4.xlsx
section: Mapping (column M, Interface) for DF-TRT-023 to DF-TRT-026 and DF-DOC-103
description: The Interface cell of five ACE-new rows reads 'New ACE interface (number in Interface Specifications v3)'. Recovery Workbench Interface Specifications v4 exists, so the cited version is out of date and the interface number is still not stated in this mapping.
evidence: v4 Mapping column M on the five rows; 05 Technical architecture holds Recovery Workbench Interface Specifications v2, v3 and v4; the mapping carries no interface number for these rows.
area: Interfaces / NLEADS credit decision and EasyApp e-signature
proposed: Keep the cell text word for word in v5 and confirm the v4 interface numbers at the next interface review; the number is a value this mapping never held.

title: Eighty rows carry the legacy key RWB-ACE-001 in the Status cell
source: 06 Data/Recovery Workbench Source to Target Mapping v4.xlsx
description: 80 of the 133 field rows read 'Waiting on RWB-ACE-001' and 53 read 'Ready'. RWB-ACE-001 is a legacy story key; after the realignment its work is carried by the ACE DB story RWB-P1-ACE001-DB, so a reader of v5 cannot tell from the cell alone which story unblocks the field.
evidence: v4 Mapping column N (80 Waiting on RWB-ACE-001, 53 Ready); split_plan.json legacy RWB-ACE-001 (disposition Split (rework), primary P1, single slice RWB-P1-ACE001-DB).
proposed: Keep the Status text unchanged and state the new story key once in the Mapping rules ('Status after realignment'); the 80/53 split stays as it is.

title: Only party_ext appears in the mapping; the other three extension tables are absent
source: 06 Data/Recovery Workbench Source to Target Mapping v4.xlsx
description: contact_point_ext, account_ext and valuation_ext are Workbench tables owned by P1 in the Ownership Map, but no row of the Mapping names them; DF-PTY-021 is the only row that reads an extension table (recovery.party_ext). A reader cannot tell from v5 where the extension fields of a contact point, an account or a valuation are stored.
evidence: v4 Mapping column I holds one _ext reference (DF-PTY-021); a scan of the 133 rows for _ext returns that row only; Ownership Map sheet Tables lists contact_point_ext, account_ext and valuation_ext (owner P1, schema rwb_source_data); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 line 1079.
proposed: State the three tables in the Mapping rules ('Extension fields') and leave the 133 field rows as they are until the LDM v10 lists the extension columns.

title: 81 of the 133 field rows carry no data product
source: 06 Data/Recovery Workbench Source to Target Mapping v4.xlsx
description: 52 rows name DP03, DP04, DP05, DP06, DP07, DP09, DP10, DP12, DP13 or DP14; 81 rows leave the cell empty. The data product is what the per-service DB stories and the P9 reporting read model quote, so an empty cell leaves the field without a data-product home.
evidence: v4 Mapping column B (81 blank rows, 52 filled rows); the Ownership Map sheet Tables carries no data-product column, so no second source supplies the value.
proposed: Leave the cell empty in v5 rather than guess a DP code; assign the 81 fields at the next LDM revision.
